The latest acknowledged native snapshot remains available for thread-stream rerenders, avoiding stale selection writes that reload the iOS keyboard session.

Adopted the parent's mostRecentEventCountRef race guard, which avoids assuming that a controlled payload applied when a newer native event arrived after the render.
